target.visibility: public by the time this demo starts (made public at the northwind-demo S6 gate)
target._visibility: This demo's work happens in public. Integrate and checkpoint run mp-data guard with --history in every demo stage, before they push, and you run it before every push of your own.

_database: stage1 is null: S3 (data move) does not apply to workbooks.
_hosting: No deployment; the public repo is the deliverable.

data_policy._execution: Public sample data, so cloud sessions are allowed. The client data plane still applies, as a rehearsal: data zone, mp-data, redaction, scrub and mpdata_ databases. Workbook cell values stay in the data zone, never in the model. From S1 on the driver runs every other command through mp-run, which hides the data zone, so a task that only works by reading it fails here too.
data_policy._consent: Not needed for public sample data. The driver checks ai_terms and client_consent only when bootstrap is false.
data_policy._retention: No retention clock: the private directory holds only public sample data, and the stage prepare lists rebuild it from the pinned commit.

secrets._rule: Demo: no secrets. The operator's own git and gh login pushes the pipeline and demo repos. From S1 on those pushes run inside mp-run, which hides the keyring, so the login must be gh's file-stored token over HTTPS (gh auth login --insecure-storage choosing HTTPS, then gh config set git_protocol https and gh auth setup-git; the gh environment item checks that gh auth status names hosts.yml, that both clones' origins are https://github.com/ URLs and that gh is git's credential helper for github.com). mp-data push and mp-data gh are for client target repos only.

must_keep: customer master: add, view and search (the 3 master-data userforms)
invoice list with status and date paid
for an open invoice: PDF invoice, Excel invoice and an .eml draft with the PDF attached
dashboard: year KPIs and monthly net chart for an as-of date
scope.email: .eml download with the PDF attached, plus Django's file email backend; Microsoft Graph drafts are out of scope for the demo
scope.dashboard: Chart.js 4.5.1 from pipeline.json stack.app_assets.chartjs (chart.umd.min.js, MIT). The S5 task of the dashboard area downloads that exact URL, unchanged, to app/invoicing/dashboard/static/dashboard/vendor/chart.umd.min.js (dashboard stands for the area id S1 picks) and writes app/invoicing/dashboard/THIRD_PARTY.md with the file name, version, URL, the sha256 of the downloaded file and the licence; no CDN links. S6.handover lists it in NOTICE.md
scope._note: S1 decides the areas; ids are snake_case. Email belongs to documents because the draft attaches the PDF. Excel output via openpyxl, PDF via WeasyPrint. The VBAGlossary table and the Instructions sheet are documentation, not app data.

commercial._milestones: Only for the payment section of the simulated quote (S1). Demos buy nothing, invoice nothing and have no purchased list; the driver checks offers only when bootstrap is false.

environment._windows_box: Not needed: no step of this demo runs Excel or Outlook.

expected_inventory._vba_line_rule: Per component code stream as olevba extracts it (no .frm header): count lines that are non-blank after strip and do not start with 'Attribute '; comment lines count. Component type from the PROJECT stream: Module= standard, Class= class, Document= document, BaseClass= userform.
expected_inventory._counting_rules: Worksheets/tables/validations/formulas via openpyxl (data_only=False; a formula cell is data_type 'f'; cached value via data_only=True). defined_names = all <definedName> in xl/workbook.xml including _xlnm.*; broken = refers_to contains #REF!. form_buttons = xl/ctrlProps objectType=Button; macro_assignments = macro= attributes in xl/drawings/drawing*.xml; activex_controls = xl/activeX/*.xml; cell_comments = <comment> in xl/comments*.xml; userform_controls = sites from olevba extract_form_strings_extended, including MultiPage pages and TabStrip; vba_references = REFERENCENAME records in the VBA dir stream.
